question: Who among the following has been appointed as the new chief of BrahMos Aerospace (November 2024)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dr. Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi** has been appointed as the new chief of BrahMos Aerospace in November 2024.
 
• BrahMos Aerospace is a joint venture between India’s Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and Russia’s NPO Mashinostroyenia.
 
• The BrahMos missile is known for its speed, precision, and versatility, making it one of the world's fastest supersonic cruise missiles.
 
• Dr. Joshi brings extensive experience in the field of missile technology and has previously held significant positions in defense research organizations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BrahMos Missile**

 
 
• The BrahMos missile is a medium-range ramjet supersonic cruise missile that can be launched from submarines, ships, aircraft, or land.
 
• It is named after the Brahmaputra River in India and the Moskva River in Russia.
 
• With a speed of Mach 2.8 to 3.0, it is one of the fastest cruise missiles in the world.
 
• The missile has a range of approximately 300 to 500 kilometers.
 
 
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**
 
 
• DRDO is an agency under the Department of Defence Research and Development in the Ministry of Defence of the Government of India.
 
• It is responsible for the development of technology for use by the military.
 
• DRDO operates around 52 laboratories across India.
 
• Its areas of work include aeronautics, armaments, electronics, land combat engineering, life sciences, materials, missiles, and naval systems.
 
 
 
• **NPO Mashinostroyenia**
 
 
• NPO Mashinostroyenia is a Russian aerospace company that designs and manufactures missiles, spacecraft, and other aerospace equipment.
 
• It is a key partner in the BrahMos joint venture.
 
• The company has been involved in several significant space missions and defense projects.
 
• NPO Mashinostroyenia was founded in 1944 and has its headquarters in Reutov, Russia.
 
 
 
• **Supersonic Cruise Missiles**
 
 
• Supersonic cruise missiles travel faster than the speed of sound, typically at speeds of Mach 2 to 3.
 
• They are designed to deliver high-precision strikes against surface targets.
 
• Such missiles can be launched from various platforms including land, sea, and air.
 
• Supersonic cruise missiles are valued for their speed and ability to evade interception.
